code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,6.6,'deck (unchanged above)',ha='center',fontsize=11)
ax.fill_between([0,10],[5.8,5.8],[6.2,6.2],color='gray',alpha=0.5)
ax.text(1.2,5.2,'girder',fontsize=10); ax.text(8.0,5.2,'girder',fontsize=10)
ax.fill_between([0.8,1.8],[4.5,4.5],[5.8,5.8],color='dimgray',alpha=0.6)
ax.fill_between([8.2,9.2],[4.5,4.5],[5.8,5.8],color='dimgray',alpha=0.6)
ax.plot([0.5,3.0],[5.0,5.0],'k-',lw=4); ax.plot([7.0,9.5],[5.0,5.0],'k-',lw=4)
ax.text(5,5.2,'transverse bearer beams',ha='center',fontsize=10)
for x in [1.3,8.7]:
    for y in [5.0,5.35,5.65]:
        ax.plot(x,y,'ko',ms=5)
ax.text(8.7,4.4,'HSFG bolt clamps',ha='right',fontsize=9)
# springs and dashpots
for x in [3.6,6.4]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[5.0,3.4],'k-',lw=1)
    ax.plot(x,4.2,'k>',ms=8); ax.plot(x,4.6,'k<',ms=8)
    ax.text(x+0.15,4.4,'spring',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([3.0,3.0],[5.0,3.4],'b-',lw=2); ax.plot([7.0,7.0],[5.0,3.4],'b-',lw=2)
ax.text(2.0,4.0,'dashpot',color='b',fontsize=8); ax.text(7.1,4.0,'dashpot',color='b',fontsize=8)
ax.fill_between([2.8,7.2],[2.2,2.2],[3.4,3.4],color='gray',alpha=0.7)
ax.text(5,2.8,'500 kg steel mass',ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.plot([2.8,7.2],[2.0,2.0],'k--',lw=1)
ax.text(5,1.6,'lockable cover + access',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.text(5,1.0,'threaded seats + shims for retune',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('',xy=(5,3.4),xytext=(5,2.2),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax.text(5.3,2.6,'stroke gap',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=110)
